part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Food and cooking
questions: What sorts of food do you like eating most? [Why?]
Who normally does the cooking in your home? [Why/Why not?]
Do you watch cookery programmes on TV? [Why/Why not?]
In general, do you prefer eating out or eating at home? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a house/apartment that someone you know lives in.
part2.closing: and explain what you like or dislike about this person's house/apartment.

topics.title: Different types of home
questions: What kinds of home are most popular in your country? Why is this?
What do you think are the advantates of living in a house rather than an apartment?
Do you think that everyone would like to live in a larger home? Why is that?

topics.title: Finding a place to live
questions: How easy is it to find a place to live in your country?
Do you think it's better to rent or to buy a place to live in? Why?
Do you agree that there is a right age for young adults to stop living with their parents? Why is that?
